message: `aria-atomic="true"` on the part sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part with its `status` and the `aria-atomic="true"` Chromium 153 derives from the role, written. It costs nothing measured and is refused by the rule, as a written `aria-live` is: Firefox 158 exposes `container-atomic` for the written one and none for the `status` alone (measured on 2026-10-27), so the engines disagree on what the role gives. A reading that refused `false` alone passed it.
